_note: The two graders agreed on all 21 items and the assertion (agreement-N7.json), so there was nothing to settle; the consensus is their agreed mapping, with grader A's reasons.

answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The reply groups fixes as 'Fix first' (1-5, 'wrong or lost bookings'), 'Fix next' (6-10) and 'Smaller fixes', and gives the order '1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 ... then 6 → 7 → 8 → 9 → 10'. It says it 'couldn't open the site in a browser' and asks for the top items to be checked 'on a real phone (360 px wide, dark mode, VoiceOver/TalkBack)'.

mapping.title: Bundle sends nothing to a server; slots and reference invented, 'today' fixed (looks like a demo)
mapping.reason: This describes how the delivered test build was put together, not a usability or accessibility problem in the booking flow. The review treats it as a scope question for the agency and reviews the flow as designed.

mapping.title: Tapping 'Book this slot' twice cancels the booking; no progress shown after the first tap
mapping.reason: It is the same harm: Book shows nothing visible, a second press within 1.5 s cancels, and the done page still says 'Booked' with a reference.

mapping.title: 5-minute hold runs out silently; misleading 'no longer available' message, slot blanked
mapping.reason: It is the unseen five-minute hold that lapses and drops the slot to a dash, with the message never saying the hold ran out.

mapping.title: Today's past and near-start slots look free but are rejected at Book
mapping.reason: Today's slots before the 30-minute cut-off can be chosen and are refused only at the end, with no link. This is D06 exactly.

mapping.title: Permit rule hidden behind an icon, field appears after 1.2 s, checked only on the confirm page
mapping.reason: It covers the icon-only rule, the delayed permit field, Next accepting an empty permit, and enforcement only on the confirm page.

mapping.title: 'Change slot' / 'Back to the slots' lose the chosen day
mapping.reason: 'Change slot' reopens the first step on Today, forgetting the day and slot already chosen.

mapping.title: No visible focus on slot buttons (injected outline:0)
mapping.reason: The injected style removes the slots' focus ring, so keyboard users cannot see which slot they are on.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots moved to the top, out of time order and out of focus/reading order
mapping.reason: The CSS order moves 'Few left' slots to the front of the grid above the headings, while Tab and screen readers keep a different order.

mapping.title: Slot grid overflows sideways at 360 px and below
mapping.reason: At 360 px and below the script sizes the columns from the window, so the grid runs past the edge, the right column is cut and the page scrolls sideways.

mapping.title: 'Few left' tag low contrast in both themes
mapping.reason: The amber 'Few left' tag measures about 3.0:1 in light and 3.4:1 in dark, against the 4.5:1 needed. The defect seeds about 3.0:1 and 3.2:1.

mapping.title: Done page lacks the day, time, vehicle and arrival window
mapping.reason: The done page shows only the reference and not the day, the slot or the vehicle booked.

mapping.title: 20-minute arrival rule only in a hover tooltip phones never show
mapping.reason: That a slot lasts 20 minutes and must be arrived within is only in the button's title tooltip, which never appears on a phone.

mapping.title: Done page shows placeholder 'DR-000000' when the reference is missing
mapping.reason: This is speculative. The review shows no way a resident in the normal flow reaches the done page without a reference. It appears only as a side note in the done-page fix.

mapping.title: No 'Loading slots…' message while slots load; Next does nothing meanwhile
mapping.reason: This is the wait itself: the slots vanish for about 0.9 s with no message, and Next gives no response.

mapping.title: 'N slots free' status gets aria-live only after its first message
mapping.reason: The status line becomes a live region only after it is first written, so the day's slot count is not announced.

mapping.title: Error-summary links point to the #vehicle/#waste containers, not the controls
mapping.reason: Following an error link puts keyboard and screen-reader residents on a container rather than the first input, so they have to hunt for the control to fix. The permit, hold and cut-off 'no link' part repeats R3-R5.

mapping.title: Vehicle choice uses aria-pressed toggle buttons instead of radio buttons
mapping.reason: aria-pressed already exposes each option's state, and the review gives no failure a resident would hit. Preferring radios ('1 of 3') is a semantic preference.

mapping.title: Vehicle error not connected to the vehicle group
mapping.reason: A screen-reader resident moving to the vehicle buttons is not told the error, so they may not know why the step won't go on or what to fix.

mapping.title: Waste checkbox error replaces the rubble hint for screen readers
mapping.reason: When the error shows, screen-reader residents lose the hint about rubble limits that they need to choose the waste correctly.

mapping.title: Registration and postcode lack autocapitalize/spellcheck settings; autocorrect may mangle them
mapping.reason: Residents mostly book on phones, where keyboard autocorrect and lower-case input can alter a registration or postcode. A wrong registration means the vehicle does not match the booking at the gate.

mapping.title: No online way to change or cancel a booking; phone line only on weekdays 09:00-17:00
mapping.reason: Residents mostly book in the evening, and those whose plans change cannot amend or cancel until a weekday office hour. They may waste a slot or arrive with the wrong booking.
